b'# tinydl

A simple command-line tool for downloading files from URLs.

## Usage

```bash
tinydl [options] <url>
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Help Text |
|--------|-----------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o, --output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q, --quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

```bash
# Download to stdout
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt

# Download to a file
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt -o output.txt

# Download to a file with quiet mode (no progress output)
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt -o output.txt -q
```
'
